__doc__: Site-specific roots for hooks/policy.py. Copy to ~/.config/agent-stack/policy.local.json
and fill in this machine's paths. That file is UNTRACKED: this repo is public, and the
roots name internal mounts, so they must not be committed. Override the location with
Missing or malformed file: the hook keeps the generic broad roots ('/', '/mnt', $HOME)
and switches off every repo-scoped rule. It never fails to start over this file.
broad_roots: directories too large to scan. find/grep -r/rg/du/ls -R rooted at one of
these is denied unless it is depth-limited. '~' is expanded. Generic roots are always
included, so list only the extras: shared mounts, the home's big subdirectories, and
the top of each large repo.
repo_roots: checkouts that carry extra conventions. Inside one of these the hook denies
standalone 'python'/'python3' (use 'uv run python'), denies 'git worktree add' with a
target inside the checkout, and adds a review note to lockfile and package-install
commands. Leave the list empty to switch all three off.
